releaseTitle: TikSave v1.1.7 (Futuristic Neon UI, Orbiting Star Border & 4-Engine Fast Resolver)
releaseNotes:
• Futuristic Neon UI Redesign: Immersive dark obsidian theme with running neon border light beams, glowing gradient cards, and smooth micro-interactions matching reference design
• Orbiting Star Border Animation: Continuous traveling star and energy light beam orbiting around card perimeters in Jetpack Compose and Web UI
• 4-Engine Instant TikTok Resolver: Blazing fast parallel extraction (TikVideo, SaveTik, TikWM, Direct Web) with IPv4-first DNS and shared CookieJar for sub-second downloads
• Original Production Keystore Preserved: Seamless in-app self-update signed with verified CN=TikSave certificate
